evidence_scope: public synthetic CPU development data; no Qwen weights, HG-03 private seeds, or real agent
dictionary_construction: k independent 6-sparse target masks split into three disjoint 2-sparse pair fragments; no 6-sparse target row present; 2-sparse decoy rows use nuisance coordinates outside all target supports; seed-shuffled rows
ablation: omit one true 2-sparse fragment per output, replace with nuisance-only pair, preserve dictionary size; certify rank deficiency of k
task_only_search: choose training-exact XOR of 3 distinct dictionary fragments; rank select by stable dictionary order, prefer uncomplemented exact match; no test/calibration data for fitting
xor1_xor2: enumerate all 1 and 2 fragment XORs, choose minimum training error with optional complement, stable ties
random_control: 100 seeded independent draws with replacement, each selects k independent 3-fragment XOR masks; fit one per-output sign from training labels; random selection does not optimize labels
input_sampling: independent train/cal/test streams; each sampled 1024-bit source truncated to cohort dimension, holding low 140 bits identical across core/padded cohorts
decision_gate: release if (calibration_joint_correct+1)/(32+2) > 3/5; payoff +10 correct, -15 incorrect, 0 abstain; 128 independent test examples

registered_gates.structural: every candidate feature has Hamming weight 2, every target weight 6, goals rank k; full dictionary has rank deficiency 0, ablated dictionary has deficiency k
registered_gates.paired_padding: fixed-pool task_xor1,task_xor2,task_xor3 predictions and release decisions identical core140/padded512/padded1024 for all 24 seeds, k, train sizes
registered_gates.compositional_recovery: with 64 training labels, task_xor3 exact test-code accuracy 128/128 in >=20 of 24 seeds for each k on core140 fixed-pool
registered_gates.xor3_beats_xor2: with 64 train labels, task_xor3 beats task_xor2 in >=20 of 24 core140 fixed-pool seeds for every k
registered_gates.random_rank: 100 output-rank-k matched random triple draws per registered seed/cohort/rank/pool and empirical rank p=(1+number_random_ge_task)/(101)
registered_gates.information_audit: width-based barrier and structural rank ceiling verified against independent exhaustive small-GF2 enumeration
registered_gates.source_provenance: source hashes and all per-seed/arm rows; preserve registration SHA and amendments

boundary: 100 random draws are label-budget and representational-rank matched but not compute-matched to triple search; oracle directly accesses true composition; no neural claims
